items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: he and a cat named Sammy Lewis. Sammy sang and he played.

ctx.x: He's listed in Chilton's book. Did you know him back in Arkansas?

No. I knew him, I think, out on the road. He used to go travel on the TOBA Time, he and a cat named Sammy Lewis. Sammy sang and he played. Then later he went with Cab. In those days the trumpet players... Most of the other good trumpet players that were famous was in New Orleans. They hadn't left New Orleans.
Getting ready to go, but not yet.
